design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote border, and industry snapshot stat values.
Tables: hairline rules, left-aligned text in first column, right-aligned numbers in data columns.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif font, italic, with a left rule in accent colour.
Industry snapshot: three stat boxes in a row, growth bars as proportional horizontal bars, split bar as a single bar with two colours.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: Specialty chemicals (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) account for about 17%
industry_snapshot.rationale: Gives the reader a quick visual of market size, growth trajectory, and fragmentation — data that prose would bury.
